Author: Ehno
Name: XIV Venue Manager Sync
Punchline: In-game companion for xivvenuemanager.com — log patron visits, sales, and services without leaving FFXIV.
Description: In-game companion for XIV Venue Manager, a venue-management platform for FFXIV player-run venues (xivvenuemanager.com). Tracks patron entry and exit at your venue, logs sales and services to your web dashboard in real time, and keeps guest lists in sync with the staff, roles, and services you configure on the website. Set up an account at xivvenuemanager.com, generate an API key from the dashboard, and paste it into this plugin's Settings tab to start syncing.
Changelog:
v3.10.2: Fixed exterior-plot tracking not clearing when you walk off the plot without a full zone change (header/guest list stayed stuck on the last venue).
v3.10.1: Fixed exterior-plot tracking not recognizing an already-saved venue when approached from outside before going in.
v3.10.0: VIP and ban badges in the live guest list. New Rooms tab for room status. New Inventory tab: link drinks to real FFXIV items, track stock, block sales at zero. Patron tracking now works from the plot exterior, not just the house interior.
v3.8.8: Staff can now claim open shifts directly from the Shifts tab.
v3.8.7: Fixed World and Data Center showing as Dev/Unknown in the Venues tab.
v3.8.6: Improved API request compatibility with CDN layers.
